subject: general
question: In January 2023, Koneru Humpy won India's first-ever silver medal at the ________ held in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Blitz Chess Championship**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The World Blitz Chess Championship is one of the annual chess tournaments organized by FIDE (the International Chess Federation).
 
• It features a faster time control than classical chess, with each player having only 3 minutes plus a 2-second increment per move.
 
• The championship attracts the world's best chess players, who compete for the title of World Blitz Champion.
 
• Koneru Humpy's silver medal in January 2023 marked a significant achievement for India in this prestigious event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIDE (Fédération Internationale des Échecs)**

 
 
• FIDE is the international organization that connects the various national chess federations around the world and acts as the governing body of international chess competition.
 
• Founded in Paris, France, on July 20, 1924, FIDE is recognized by the International Olympic Committee as the supreme body responsible for overseeing all aspects of competitive chess.
 
• FIDE organizes world championships and other major tournaments, including the World Blitz Chess Championship.
 
 
 
• **Blitz Chess**
 
 
• Blitz chess is a fast-paced version of chess where each player has a total of 3 minutes with a 2-second increment per move to complete all their moves.
 
• This format tests not only a player's skill but also their speed and ability to perform under pressure.
 
• It is popular among both professional and amateur players due to its dynamic and thrilling nature.
 
 
 
• **Koneru Humpy**
 
 
• Koneru Humpy is an Indian chess Grandmaster, one of the strongest female players in the world.
 
• She has won several prestigious titles, including the Women's World Rapid Chess Championship in 2019.
 
• Her silver medal in the World Blitz Chess Championship 2023 was a historic achievement for Indian chess.
 
 
 
• **Almaty, Kazakhstan**
 
 
• Almaty is the largest city in Kazakhstan and has hosted numerous international sports events, including chess tournaments.
 
• The city is known for its vibrant culture and has played a significant role in promoting chess in the region.
